name: zerodha-mutual-fund-sell-liquid-within-the-load-period
describes: A ₹1,00,000 redemption from a liquid scheme three days after subscription. The load is expressed as a holding-period predicate rather than as bands, which is the other half of AC-6: the charge exists on the profile and applies only because #holdingDays says it does. No securities transaction tax — the scheme is not equity-oriented.
